svg.title: Space Liner - interpreted silhouette
svg.desc: Traders and Gunboats (2024), printed 92-93, PDF 93-94. Three-deck projection follows wider middle deck with rounded forward cap, long parallel cabin tube and stepped rear machinery collar/central stern recess. Upper and lower decks are contained. Illustration corroborates cylindrical liner and aft collar. Deliberately slender at token size; no widening or interior stateroom details added.
